name: Example: A game HUD
description: A small arena played with a keyboard and mouse or a gamepad, its HUD the UI kit's game pieces: a character with an orbiting camera, health and stamina bars, a hotbar with cooldowns, a crosshair with hit markers on the crates, nameplates, a waypoint and the crates' health over the world, a compass and a minimap, a notification feed, an objective tracker, subtitles, a dialogue with an NPC, a radial emote menu, input prompts that follow the device, and a pause menu with an inventory and a settings menu (the theme, the UI scale, reduced motion, the subtitles and the controls page, saved in the browser).
